rubrics.justification: It misstates Gardner stage 2 as a full blastocyst and calls 2BA 'high-quality'/'one of the highest quality scores'; stage interpretation is inaccurate, though ICM B and TE A descriptions are broadly consistent.

It integrates age, smoking, PCOS, BMI, prior failed cycle, endometrium, and sperm parameters with prognosis reasonably well, though some links (e.g., low MII yield implying dysfunction) are somewhat overstated.

Overall structure is logical, but there are notable inconsistencies: it labels the embryo excellent despite a 2BA score, uses questionable percentage deductions, and infers suboptimal ovarian response from 8 MII in PCOS without enough support.

SET recommendation, smoking cessation, and antagonist use in PCOS are guideline-concordant, but recommending PGT-A as 'highly recommended' after one failed cycle at age 36 is stronger than evidence-based guidance, and morphology grading interpretation is off.

Provides clear next steps including SET, smoking cessation, metabolic screening, and possible uterine evaluation/future planning; practical overall, though some recommendations are a bit overreaching.
